title: pellaea gracilis
intro: Pellaea gracilis, commonly known as the slender button fern, is a species of fern native to eastern Australia. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea gracilis are thought to be attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and viruses, as well as its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
